fusion.logic: The same projected media buffer is physically available before semantic decode; local proxy shows avoidable copy cost, so direct synchronous readout is the cheapest executable feature-reuse candidate.
Strong multimodal embedding behavior is explicitly trained in these systems; feature reuse remains plausible but raw metric calibration is not established.

GUI perception has exploitable spatial/temporal redundancy, but aggressive crop/history assumptions can hide state; use adaptive ROI+context+anchors and action-grounded memory with adversarial fixtures.
Current runtime failure ecology makes image-containing restart/cache/backend validation a release-relevant q23 obligation.
No current official Qwen3.6 <=4B replacement; Gemma 4 is a challenger but violates strict <=4B total accounting, so no model switch is justified.
If calibrated familiarity exists, EAP should receive compact provenance-bound seed/descriptor metadata, not raw token tensors; memory remains context-only and wrong-seed controls are mandatory.
